name: coordkit
description: Claude Code orchestration: a shared bus + ledger that warns about concurrent edits and tracks running subagents, with an opt-in hard anti-clobber guard and skill auto-activation built in (coordkit). coordguard was merged into coordkit at 3.0.0, and skillkit was merged in at 4.0.0 — both are no longer separate entries in this marketplace.

plugins.name: coordkit
plugins.description: Same-machine coordination bus + cross-instance ledger + skill auto-activation, plus an opt-in hard anti-clobber guard (merged in from coordguard at 3.0.0). WARN-only by default: tracks who else is live in a repo, which files they touch, and which subagents they're running, and surfaces it — never blocks a tool call. Run /guard on to enable guard mode, which additionally denies a Write/Edit when the target file changed on disk since this session last read it. Also matches prompts against layered skill-rules.json files to suggest skills, and ships a shared roster of specialized agents and /dev-docs commands (merged in from skillkit at 4.0.0).
